name: segmented-control
title: Segmented control
description: Switches between two to five views or filters in place.

SegmentedControlSegment.description: One segment, for SegmentedControl's children. Takes its size and shape from the control.

props.name: items
props.description: The segments as data. Or leave it out and write them as `SegmentedControlSegment` children.

props.name: children
props.description: The segments as elements, when they need more than a label and an icon (a Badge, a Tooltip around one).

props.name: border
props.description: A border-subtle outline around the track (border-width/strong: the track is a control).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required when the segments have no visible text of their own.
